summary: Iteration 23 big-batch (annual billing, Stripe portal, guest revocation, AI credits metadata, standup digest, mobile tab bar, Deepgram) — 12/12 backend pytest PASS and all critical frontend flows verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: Stripe portal: 400 path is clear, but consider showing the user a UI nudge in /billing that 'Manage Portal' will appear after first successful checkout — current FE just hides the button silently which may confuse owners who never see it.

billing/checkout: when annual price IDs are eventually set in env, the 400 path becomes unreachable — add an integration test that verifies a 200 + Stripe subscription URL when STRIPE_PRO_ANNUAL_PRICE_ID is configured (gated by env presence).

routes/chats.py DELETE guest endpoint: doesn't verify caller is owner/admin — any chat member can remove a guest. Consider requiring elevated role to revoke (or at least logging who did it; metadata.event='guest_removed' captures it which is good).

services/ai_runtime.py credits_total/breakdown is computed only from responses with `real==True`. If all model calls fail (e.g., rate-limit), the message will show credits_total=0 — make sure the UI badge handles 0 credits gracefully (e.g., 'no credits charged' label) instead of blank.
routes/dashboard.py /standup/generate has no rate limit — an owner could spam this and burn AI credits. Consider 1-call-per-minute throttle per workspace.
test_credentials: Owner: amit@demo.team / Demo@2026 via POST /api/auth/demo-login. Member: raj@demo.team / Demo@2026.
seed_data_creation: TestGuestRevocation creates fresh chat (type='group') + fresh guest user 'guest.revoke+<ts>@external.io' per run. Not cleaned up (timestamp-isolated). TestAIAnswerCreditsMetadata posts '@ai say hi in 5 words please' into first chat and consumes ~34 credits per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend coverage in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration23_big_batch.py: (1) GET /billing/plans returns annual_price_usd=200/500 + annual_available=false (STRIPE_*_ANNUAL_PRICE_ID env not set); (2) POST /billing/checkout billing_cycle=annual → 400 'annual billing not set up'; monthly default → 200 + checkout.stripe.com URL; member → 403; (3) POST /billing/portal owner no-customer → 400 'No Stripe customer record yet', member → 403; (4) POST /standup/generate {} → markdown+stats{open,completed_yesterday,overdue,due_today}+generated_at; with {chat_id} → also posts message to chat (verified by message count delta); (5) POST /chats/{id}/invite-guest then GET /chats/{id}/guests returns guest in list (uses field 'id' not 'user_id'); DELETE /chats/{id}/guests/{user_id} → {ok:true, still_in_workspace:bool}, guest removed from list, system message 'X removed' posted; (6) @ai message in chat → ai_answer.metadata contains credits_total (int) + credits_breakdown (list of {model_key,model_name,credits}); (7) POST /calls/{id}/transcribe-chunk with empty webm returns 200/400/422, never 500 (Deepgram path tested at integration level). Frontend coverage via Playwright: /billing shows billing-cycle-toggle with billing-cycle-monthly/annual buttons, clicking annual updates Pro card to '$17/month (annual) — $200/YR BILLED ANNUALLY' and Team to '$42/month (annual) — $500/YR BILLED ANNUALLY' (17% off badge visible); billing-manage-portal correctly HIDDEN on free plan; Dashboard dash-standup-btn → POST /standup/generate → dash-standup-result renders real markdown digest in ~10s (TL;DR + overdue 30 + sections), dash-standup-close hides it; mobile-tab-bar at 390x844 shows 5 tabs (chats/tasks/ai/friends/me); invite-guest-btn opens dialog (existing-guests list only renders when chat has remaining guests — verified empty path with new-email form); ai-model-badge + rerun-premium-btn render on @ai answers, ai-model-tooltip appears on hover.
rca of the issue: N/A — initial false-positive on credits_total being missing was a stale-message bug in my test (picked up an old ai_answer from prior iteration which predated the credits field). After filtering by id-not-in-pre-snapshot AND metadata.status=='complete', test confirmed credits_total + credits_breakdown ARE present in fresh ai_answer messages.
